name: KIM LIVE PROVIDER + DATA MESH FOUNDATION

4over4.live_activation: requires verified account/API/FTP details and provider authorization

vistaprint.live_activation: requires verified reseller authorization and supported integration path

rules: Never store plaintext credentials in source, database seed files, CSVs, logs, or AI prompts.
All outbound vendor requests require idempotency keys, audit events, timeout/retry policy, and response validation.
A provider may be marked LIVE only after a successful authenticated sandbox/test transaction or provider-confirmed production handshake.

Do not invent undocumented vendor endpoints. 4OVER4 states API/FTP integration is evaluated case-by-case for high-volume resellers; VistaPrint requires authorized reseller use for third-party resale workflows.
